name: GenConViT ED (ConvNeXt-T + Swin-T hybrid) deepfake video/face detector
reason: Measured locally (2026-09-21) and rejected: on the eval_corpus/face benchmark (SBI self-blend positives vs diverse real portraits, 98 samples) AUROC 0.49 with FPR@50 0.42 — random separation plus heavy false-flagging of real faces. Trained on FF++/DFDC-style forgeries; does not transfer to self-blend artifacts. Revisit only if real faceswap video samples arrive.
limitations: This profile never produces scores; it exists to document the measured rejection.
Even when wired, scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label.
